summary: Iteration 4 deep retest. Iter-4 fixes VERIFIED working: (a) Toaster moved to bottom-right with 2200ms — confirmed visually no longer overlaps the orange action buttons. (b) Receipt window.open opens synchronously — popup captured successfully via expect_page() for receipt #2 (Vikram, ₹50,000, Cash, SG-01002). (c) Auth-refresh fix from iter-3 still holds — page.goto on /leads renders cleanly. PASSING flows: FLOW1 (login), FLOW_A (refresh), FLOW2 (dashboard+admin sidebar+ADMIN badge), FLOW3 (cleanup of leftover ARIJIT ROY + Rajesh Kumar — DeepTest via approve-delete in /approvals), FLOW4 (Rajesh Kumar — DeepTest4 lead created with all fields incl. requirement+reminder), FLOW11 (Vikram Mehta — DeepTest4 customer created), FLOW14-partial (receipt SG-01002 created and visible in table). HOWEVER a NEW critical blocker surfaced: a CRA dev-server runtime-error overlay (red 'Uncaught runtime errors: ERROR — ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications') is appearing on the production preview URL and OPAQUE-OVERLAYS THE ENTIRE APP, blocking all subsequent clicks. It fires repeatedly when Radix Select dropdowns open/close (very common interaction in this app — used in LeadFormDialog, ReceiptDialog, ProjectDialog, etc.). This made FLOW5 (Lead B Anita Sharma create) fail immediately after FLOW4 (lead-input-name selector timeout because the dialog could not be opened — error overlay was on top). FLOW6 (status change submenu hover) also failed — Set Status submenu items never appeared. FLOWS 6,7,8,9,10,12,13,15-31 were therefore not driven end-to-end this iteration because Lead A never reached Site Visit nor Converted state. The ResizeObserver warning is benign in itself, but CRA's overlay treating it as an uncaught error and rendering a full-screen modal is a SHIPPING-BLOCKER for the preview build. Either (a) ship a production build (npm run build / yarn build) for the preview environment, OR (b) install the resize-observer-polyfill / suppress the warning, OR (c) disable react-error-overlay for ResizeObserver loops (well-known React+Radix issue).

rca of the issue:
Two issues:
  1. ResizeObserver overlay: Radix UI Select fires ResizeObserver internally; under React+CRA dev mode, react-error-overlay treats the benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning as an uncaught error and renders an iframe-based full-page modal. Mitigation: serve a production build, OR add to src/index.js: `const e = window.console.error; window.addEventListener('error', (ev) => { if (ev.message?.includes('ResizeObserver loop')) ev.stopImmediatePropagation(); }, true);` and similarly for 'unhandledrejection'.
  2. Set Status submenu: nested DropdownMenuSub items not exposed as [role=menuitem] from the start — likely needs explicit DropdownMenuSubTrigger / DropdownMenuSubContent wiring + data-testids on each status item.
